notes.title: Playtesters, Localizers & Supporters
notes.content:
Shroud of Gloom is currently in development, and you can now contribute to the game and get your name in the credits! This is a chance to play a part in shaping Shroud of Gloom before its official release.

Playtesters
Try the game early, give feedback, and help us create a better experience.
Apply as a Playtester

Localizers
Translate the game into different languages to ensure players worldwide can enjoy the horror.
Apply as a Localizer

Supporters
Last but not least, people who support the development over at Twitch will also be credited.
Watch the development on Twitch

Thank you very much for your consideration in contributing to the game - but don't forget, the most important thing you can do to help out is to Wishlist & Follow the game on Steam!

notes.title: Welcome to Shroud of Gloom
notes.content:
Watch the Development
Follow the development live on Twitch: I stream the creation of the game, from coding and pixel art to designing rooms and puzzles. Stop by, ask questions, and get a behind-the-scenes look at how horror comes to life.

You can also join the Discord server if you want to connect with the community!

About the Game
Shroud of Gloom is an upcoming point-and-click horror game where you solve puzzles and uncover secrets with nothing but a flickering flashlight to guide your way.

Wishlist now to be notified when the demo drops!

This game was originally developed for the GDFG's Monthly Game Jam #36, where it ranked 1st in every category, now coming to Steam as a longer and improved version!

The darkness is closing in. Are you ready? 🔦
